user.title: OpenRouter management key
user.description: Enter an OpenRouter **management key** (Settings → Management Keys). It is read-only and gives access to your account's Analytics API, which powers these sensors.

reauth_confirm.title: Reauthenticate OpenRouter
reauth_confirm.description: The stored key no longer works. Enter a valid management key.

error.invalid_key: Could not validate this key. Double-check it and try again.
error.not_management_key: This key cannot access Analytics. Use a management key, not a regular API key.
error.cannot_connect: Could not reach OpenRouter. Check your network and try again.

init.title: OpenRouter Activity options
init.description: Choose which time window the sensors cover and how often they refresh.
